# bronto_slack_workspaces (Data Source)

Lists Slack workspaces already connected to this org through the Bronto UI's OAuth flow.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bronto_slack_workspaces" "all" {}

output "connected_slack_workspaces" {
  value = data.bronto_slack_workspaces.all.workspaces
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for this data source.
- `workspaces` (Attributes List) The connected Slack workspaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspaces))

<a id="nestedatt--workspaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspaces`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the workspace. This is an internal Bronto identifier, not Slack's own workspace/team ID.
- `name` (String) The name of the Slack workspace.
